verdict.rationale: Sunbiz is the State of Florida's official business-entity registry and filing portal. Its records are public filings held by the state under its own jurisdiction, so letting a user pick a storage region or residency is a category error for this kind of product, not a missing feature. Nothing in the evidence suggests any user-selectable data residency.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
